body:
Context: Issue #831. herdr-plugin.toml declares min_herdr_version = "0.7.4" and plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/watcher.mjs pins TESTED_CEILING = "0.7.4". versionGate(versionOutput, ceiling) in plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/tokens.mjs returns supported: false whenever any version component exceeds the ceiling, so even a patch release (e.g. 0.7.5) disables the watcher while the board renders with no indication that the herdr version is untested.
Changes:
1. Export TESTED_CEILING from plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/tokens.mjs and update versionGate(versionOutput, ceiling) so patch releases within the same major.minor series (version[0] === ceil[0] && version[1] === ceil[1]) are supported ({ supported: true }), while major or minor bumps above the ceiling still return { supported: false, token: `untested herdr version ${match[0]} (tested <= ${ceiling})` }.
2. Update plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/board-render.mjs renderBoard() to accept an optional warning string and render a warning banner line below the header separator (accounting for it in plannedRows height budgeting).
3. Update plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/board.mjs gather() to probe herdr --version via probeOutcome(await runHerdr(['--version']), TESTED_CEILING) and pass warning: outcome.token when outcome.kind === 'unsupported'.
Acceptance Criteria:
- AC1: versionGate("herdr 0.7.5", "0.7.4") returns { supported: true }, while versionGate("herdr 0.8.0", "0.7.4") and versionGate("herdr 1.0.0", "0.7.4") return { supported: false, token: ... }.
- AC2: renderBoard({ ..., warning }) renders the sanitized warning line and includes it in plannedRows height budgeting; bin/board.mjs surfaces the warning when herdr --version exceeds TESTED_CEILING.
- AC3: node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/*.test.mjs and mutation-gate pass.
title: fix(adlc-herdr): tolerate patch bumps in versionGate and render unsupported banner on board (#831)
